summary.zh: 优化 App Store 与 Google Play 的标题、关键词和评分
summary.en: Improve App Store and Google Play listings, keywords and review scores

description.zh: 针对 App Store 和 Google Play 的商店页做优化：挑关键词、写标题和副标题、看竞品、核对字符限制，并判断评论对转化的影响。适合新应用上线前、排名下滑或准备改版商店页时使用。附带评分和检查脚本，需要本地 Python 环境运行。
description.en: Tunes App Store and Google Play listings: keywords, title and subtitle, competitors, length limits and review impact. Use before launch, when rankings slip, or ahead of a rewrite. Ships Python scripts, so a local setup is needed.
